evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and adds the AssertUnreachable() macro to src/util/check.h.
rationale: Introduces AssertUnreachable() in util/check.h to provide proper [[noreturn]] semantics without triggering compiler warnings under GCC or clang-cl on Windows. This establishes a clean, unified unreachable-assertion pattern that eliminates false-positive -Wreturn-type warnings across compilers.
